summary: An excellent Blitz: nearly every island a casual player names scores. It also passes as a classic list, but it already ran as Today's list on 2026-10-25, and the classic game punishes Australia and Japan.
reasons: Casual classic: Greenland, New Guinea, Borneo, Madagascar and Great Britain, then lives gone on Australia, Iceland, Japan, Cuba and Ireland. 5/10.
Iceland (#18), Cuba (#16) and Ireland (#20) are fair near misses, but Australia and Japan cost a life with no rank and no stat, which feels like a trick.
In Blitz 18 of 20 casual names score (Iceland, Cuba, Sri Lanka, Tasmania, Sicily, Java, Taiwan, Hawaii), so it is deep and fun.
fixes: 'Australia' and 'Antarctica' are accepted unranked answers, so the most common first wrong guess costs a life. Make continents free, or add '(continents don't count)' to the prompt.

'Japan', 'Indonesia' and 'Philippines' are accepted country entries that cost a life, while 'UK' and 'PNG' resolve to Great Britain and New Guinea. Either add 'Japan' as an alias choice for Honshu or make these archipelago countries free.

Junk aliases on top-10 entries: Borneo 'Borneo flags'; New Guinea 'New Guinea Man'; Sumatra 'Sumatera Celebes', 'ID-SM', 'Eastern Sumatra'; Greenland 'Kangat Bay', 'Lupanglunti', 'Lupanlunti'; Baffin Island 'Nunavut' (and typing 'nunavut' currently autocorrects to Greenland).
